players.label: Sonos S2 speakers
players.description: Choose speakers whose physical Play button should start fallback media when nothing is loaded. Requires the native Music Assistant Sonos S2 provider.

fallback_uri.label: Default fallback media URI
fallback_uri.description: Music Assistant radio station or playlist URI. Used for all selected speakers unless a per-speaker override is configured. Leave blank to disable playback.

cooldown_seconds.label: Repeat-event cooldown (seconds)
cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum time between handled empty-content errors per speaker. Prevents repeated Play presses and device event bursts from launching multiple times.

log_skips.label: Log ignored attempts
log_skips.description: Write info-level diagnostics for failed safety checks and missing media configuration. No fallback is started for an unsafe state.

manifest.description: Start chosen Music Assistant radio or playlist media when selected Sonos S2 hardware reports no content on Play and its MA queue is empty.
